movie.title: Lion
movie.overview: A five-year-old Indian boy gets lost on the streets of Calcutta, thousands of kilometers from home. He survives many challenges before being adopted by a couple in Australia; 25 years later, he sets out to find his lost family.

facts: The heart of 'Lion' begins with a truly harrowing experience: a five-year-old Indian boy suddenly finds himself completely lost on the vast streets of Calcutta.
Imagine the distance! This little boy is thousands of kilometers from his actual home, facing unknown challenges all on his own.
After navigating immense difficulties, he's adopted by a couple in Australia, and it's not until a quarter-century later that he embarks on a remarkable journey to find his lost family.
